assertions.name: rename-key-migrated
assertions.target: storage key migrated with old key absent

assertions.name: rename-sku-prefix
assertions.target: SKU prefix migrated with no retired SKU active

rationale: The task card states the new storage key cv-cart-v2 and new SKU prefix CV-, while the pack inputs give the old key nb-cart-v1 and old prefix NB- in storage.js and sku.list. Required outcomes are the new key present with the old string absent and retired SKUs inactive. The pack leaves underdetermined the exact SKU renumbering mapping and the retired_sku_active boolean semantics beyond false.
